messages:
Kai (Support): incident-bot just paged oncall for customer Lumenix — massive token count delta on their dedicated pool lumenix-prod. Billing alerted: ~+300% tokens last 60m. Customer complaining about unexpected usage charges. Can we triage?

incident-bot: Paging Maya (oncall) — Severity: P1. Runbook: tokenization-anomaly. Bridge: <https://meet.redwood/incident/1932501111>

Maya (oncall): ack — joining bridge now. @Samir @Elaine can you grab runtime + tokenizer logs? Ash, loop in the CSM if this is customer-facing.

Samir (eng-runtime): on it. I can already see an uptick in input lengths hitting lumenix-prod katana nodes. 99th token latency is fine but token counts per request jumped ~2x for a lot of requests. Checking model-serving config and recent deploys.

Elaine (eng-ml): fyi we rolled a tokenizer normalization change to "unicode-normalize-v2" as part of a patch 2h ago; it was intended to reduce token variance. Looks like dedicated pools got the rollout too. I'm pulling the commit.

Ash (CSE): Lumenix confirmed they send pre-tokenized payloads occasionally (they do some server-side preproc for emojis). They said nothing changed on their side.

Samir (eng-runtime): hypothesis: double-tokenization — client pretokenized + server normalization step treating the input differently, or normalization produced different codepoints (NFKC vs NFC) and increased token count. Elaine, can you confirm the exact normalization semantics?

Elaine (eng-ml): the patch applies NFKC and also splits combined emoji sequences differently. That will change token counts for e.g. "👩‍⚕️" and some composed unicode. For most customers it's fine, but if someone sends already-tokenized text or relies on old splitting, counts can blow up.

Maya (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) isolate lumenix-prod to an isolated pool to stop blast radius, 2) rollback tokenizer change on that pool to previous behavior, 3) throttle tenant to prevent runaway billing, 4) notify customer and billing. I'm creating tasks now.

Samir (eng-runtime): creating temporary route to lumenix-isolation pool and binding their tenant. Applying patch:
```bash
# create isolation route
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: inference.redwood/v1
kind: TrafficRoute
metadata:
  name: lumenix-isolate
spec:
  tenant: lumenix
  destinationPool: lumenix-isolation
  annotations:
    reason: tokenization-burst-1932501111
EOF
```
I'll set override-tokenizer=unicode-normalize-v1 on that pool so it's back to prior behavior.

Samir (eng-runtime): done — traffic now routing to lumenix-isolation (4 nodes). Metrics show client requests shifted over.

Samir (eng-runtime): also disabling KV prefix caching for lumenix to avoid repeated extra tokens being accumulated across requests:
```bash
redwoodctl tenant update lumenix --disable-prefix-cache
```

Nate (Billing): putting an emergency billing cap in place now — hard cap at 2x of last week's avg for lumenix to avoid runaway charges. Posting note to billing queue to prepare credit if needed.

Ash (CSE): notifying Lumenix CSM and PM. Sending a short message to customer (draft):
> "We're investigating increased token counts on your integration and have temporarily isolated your traffic to prevent further charges. We're rolling back a server change on your dedicated pool and will follow up with details. No action needed on your side right now."

Jordan (PM): good. Please include timeline and root-cause hypothesis in the customer note. Also schedule post-incident meeting.

Elaine (eng-ml): I can do a targeted rollback for the tokenizer flag on lumenix-isolation: setting token_normalization=legacy in config. Pushing change now.

Elaine (eng-ml): rollback applied. Samir — do you see token counts drop?

Samir (eng-runtime): early signs good — token rates per request dropping back toward baseline. CPU and GPU token accounting aligning. Will monitor next 10 minutes.

Maya (oncall): great. Action items: Samir keep isolation + cache disabled until postmortem; Elaine open PR to add tenant-aware rollout gating; Nate prepare credit memo + invoice correction; Ash send customer note with ETA; Jordan schedule 30m RCA. I'll keep the bridge open for 30m and then cutover to async updates.

Nate (Billing): flagging for finance — potential credit ~30-40k estimate, pending exact token reconciliation.

Ash (CSE): sent customer update. Lumenix replied: "thanks for the quick action, we'll hold any changes on our side." CSM on the bridge now.

Samir (eng-runtime): follow-up command I ran to pin tokenizer on the isolation pool:
```bash
kubectl patch pool lumenix-isolation --type=merge -p '{"spec":{"tokenizer":"legacy-v1"}}'
```
Verification: token_count_delta for lumenix decreased from +320% -> +8% in 12m.

Maya (oncall): marking incident as mitigated for customer impact. Not closing — needs postmortem and billing reconciliation. I'll create an incident ticket in JIRA: INF-1932501111. Assigning to Elaine/Samir/Jordan/Nate/Ash.

Jordan (PM): please include the following in the postmortem: what changed, why dedicated pools were included in rollout, why tenant pre-tokenization wasn't detected, and remediation timeline. Also add tests for pre-tokenized inputs.

Elaine (eng-ml): will draft root cause: tokenizer normalization change (unicode-normalize-v2) applied to dedicated pools without tenant-aware rollout, causing incompatible token splits for pre-tokenized inputs and composed unicode sequences. Proposed fixes: tenant-aware rollout flag, guardrail to detect >100% token delta in 15m window and auto-isolate, and a preflight hook for tenants that declare pre-tokenized payloads.

Maya (oncall): thanks all. Bridge will stay for monitoring until 1932501367 then I'll close voice bridge. Leaving thread for async updates.

Kai (Support): filing support follow-up and will attach customer messages + billing ticket reference.

incident-bot: Incident INF-1932501111 status=mitigated assigned=[Maya,Samir,Elaine,Jordan,Nate,Ash]
